scripts.studio: npm run audio && remotion studio src/video/index.ts
scripts.build: npm run audio && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.render: npm run audio && remotion render src/video/index.ts MotionShowreel out/dynamic-motion.mp4 --props=video.config.json --codec=h264 --crf=17 --concurrency=2
scripts.render:preview: npm run audio && remotion render src/video/index.ts MotionShowreel out/preview.mp4 --props=video.config.json --codec=h264 --concurrency=2 --width=540 --height=960 --frames=0-299
